verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms an official Nitrokey Python SDK package on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2) alongside the official pynitrokey/nitropy tooling. A community report praises Nitrokey's dev tools and documentation for HSM integration via OpenSC. Support stays thin: the SDK is an early-version, single-language package with no SDK-specific docs in the pack, and one hands-on report notes some HSM functions need a custom vendor shell rather than standard PKCS#11. Missing for 10: first-party SDK API documentation, SDKs for multiple languages, a mature (1.x) SDK release, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.
